Five-Star Hotel
Seven Safe S.A.

MS Project · Excel · PMBOK · Cumbaya, Quito · 2021–2023

End-to-end project management plan for the construction of a biosecurity-focused five-star hotel. As Project Manager, delivered 12+ formal PMBOK documents: project charter, 8-phase WBS with dictionary, MS Project Gantt (582 workdays, 3 milestones), stakeholder matrix, environmental analysis, 8 architectural floor plans, organizational charts, and a 10-year financial model across four room types.

Role & Context

Project Manager — Jefe del Proyecto
My Role
Project Manager (Jefe del Proyecto). Responsible for the full PMBOK lifecycle — initiation, planning, execution, monitoring & control, and closure. Produced and signed all management documents.
Project Sponsor
Seven Safe Hotel S.A. — legally constituted S.A. company registered with Ecuador's Superintendencia de Compañías, with notarized charter, bank certificate, RUC, and Registro Mercantil inscription.
Main Contractor
Cimientos S.A. — responsible for construction phases, coordinated through the PM's WBS, schedule, and scope framework.
Building Scope
3,550 m² · 5 floors + 3 basement levels · 15 rooms (4 types) · Restaurant 42 pax · Bar 30 pax · Pool, gym, spa, retail.
